title: CMake: FetchArtifacts updates
description:
Put our arm64 and x64 sections in alphabetical order. Install
winflexbison on both architectures.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: @geraldcombs @AndersBroman [lua-5.4.7-unicode-win64.zip](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark-development-libraries/-/tree/main/public/windows/packages/lua) exists. Should fetch artifacts grab it instead of 5.4.6?
No, I think that was a test I did. Not sure the content is ok.
